notes.title: Release date and display issues in Steam
notes.notes:
Friends, we want to clarify the situation regarding the release date. We've noticed that Steam is displaying an incorrect release date on our store page, even though we had already adjusted it earlier this year. In our developer dashboard, the correct date is set, but for some reason, the store page shows something different.

We understand that this has caused confusion and concern, so we've already reached out to Steam Support to resolve the issue. Just to clarify, Steam does not allow developers to change the release date at the last minute, and doing so could result in serious restrictions from the platform.

Thank you for your patience and understanding! We’ll keep you updated as soon as we get a response from Steam.

notes.title: Development News: the return of Mike Goes on Hike!
notes.notes:
Greetings everyone!

It's been a while since the last news, and a lot has happened in that period. It seemed as if a higher power was preventing us from releasing Mike Goes on Hike - the game underwent many changes, the concepts were constantly evolving. At one point we had to suspend development because things weren't going according to plan.

After a two-year hiatus, we returned to our projects at the end of last year. We are now working on the release of [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2636000/House_of_Lost_Souls/]House of Lost Souls[/url] and continuing development on [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/912000/Mike_goes_on_hike/]Mike Goes on Hike[/url]. We like the latest version of the concept very much, and we hope you will like it too. We will try to update the project page soon to show you the new look of the project. It takes time, but it is important in order to fulfill your expectations and to better understand what you expect from the game.

We want to assure you that development is in full swing. We are closer to release than ever before and have put all our efforts into completing the game. For a long time the project was “in a long box” for various reasons, but now we are closing all the remaining tasks to release a quality product. If nothing unexpected happens again (we hope everything goes according to plan), [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/912000/Mike_goes_on_hike/]Mike Goes on Hike[/url] is expected to be released in the second quarter of this year.

We are grateful to everyone who is waiting for our games and we are doing our best to justify your trust.

And while we're finalizing development, we want to know: what can you expect from [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/912000/Mike_goes_on_hike/]Mike Goes on Hike[/url]? Share your thoughts in the comments - it will help us to better understand your expectations and make the game even better!

Thanks for your support!

notes.title: MIKE GOES ON HIKE is alive!
notes.notes:
Dear friends!

Long time no news from us, and immediately a question "What happens to the project? The project has been frozen for a long time, we never got around to it for a variety of reasons. With a small team of two people, we decided, given the importance and magnitude of the project, the implementation through early access, gradually, that the project does not hang and not dead on the expanses of steam. With your support, we will be able to implement and fit everything you expect from "Mike goes on hike" as we see it together with you. This seems to us to be the best solution. 
 
We hope for your understanding and support!
